newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices subdued on poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices subdued on poor demand.

text.p: Sugar prices were subdued on Tuesday in dull trade on poor demand, dealers said.
"There is a lull in demand after some consistent upward movement," said a trader. "Demand is expected to pick up again."

In ready, S-30 lost five rupees to 1,340/1,375 rupees per quintal. M-30 was down 10 rupees at 1,385/1,460 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery was offerd 10/20 rupees higher at 1,280/1,310 rupees per quintal.
"Sugar is expected to recover and gain further in the next few days," said a trader.
